title: Isolate the Windows incoming-commit audit Git fixture
outcome: Isolate the Windows incoming-commit audit Git fixture
acceptance: The incoming_commit_audit_reads_complete_real_git_selection_and_requires_its_canonical_owner fixture uses the repository's isolated Git command path and ignores inherited repository/index overrides and ambient config/hooks/templates.
The fixture still proves complete real Git selection and canonical-owner admission in its private checkout, with no change to a surrounding repository or index.
